title: VALES I: the molecular gas content in star-forming dusty H-ATLAS galaxies up to z = 0.35
question: What is the molecular gas content, size, star-formation law and star-formation efficiency of dusty H-ATLAS star-forming galaxies at z<0.35, measured via ALMA CO(1-0)?

data.sensitivity: Cycle-1 design 1.5 mJy/beam at 50 km/s; Cycle-2 design 2 mJy/beam at 30 km/s; achieved average rms 1.6 mJy/beam at 50 km/s

what.value: Cycle-2 [CII] PACS spectroscopy and IR luminosities/stellar masses for comparison

evidence.quote: in Cycle-2 we targeted 27 galaxies that have previous Herschel PACS [C ii] spectroscopy as shown by Ibar et al. (2015)
we estimate these using Eqn. 4 from Zhang et al. 2009

what.value: Literature CO samples (SMGs, BzK, local spirals, ULIRGs, etc.) combined in fits

evidence.quote: Our sample is compared to other studies taken from the literature

external_data.citation: Daddi et al. 2010a; Solomon et al. 1997; Leroy et al. 2008; Ivison et al. 2011; Saintonge et al. 2011; others

what.value: MAGPHYS SED fits of GAMA (stellar masses)

evidence.quote: in our present study we use the derived stellar masses and their uncertainties

external_data.citation: Driver et al. 2016; da Cunha et al. 2008

recipe.goal: Image cubes at optimal velocity resolution
recipe.method: Clean cubes at 20-100 km/s, pick resolution maximising number of >5 sigma point-like detections; 100 km/s if undetected; then re-clean with primary beam correction
key_parameters: natural weighting, 256x256 pixels, 3 sigma clean threshold

recipe.goal: Fit line and measure integrated CO flux
recipe.method: Single Gaussian fit to spectrum for centre/FWHM; collapse cube over ±1 FWHM; fit 2D Gaussian with gaussfit (irregular aperture for 7 sources); non-detections collapsed ±250 km/s

recipe.goal: Derive IR luminosity, SFR, stellar mass
recipe.method: Modified blackbody SED fit integrated 8-1000 um with Monte-Carlo errors (100 iterations); SFR = 1e-10 L_IR; stellar mass from MAGPHYS
assumptions: Chabrier IMF; 1.72 factor Salpeter to Chabrier

recipe.goal: CO luminosity and molecular gas mass
recipe.method: L'CO from Eqn 2; M_H2 = alpha_CO L'CO with morphology-dependent alpha_CO
assumptions: alpha_CO = 4.6 for B/D galaxies, 0.8 for mergers/interacting

recipe.method: Deconvolved CO sizes via gaussfit; Petrosian radii ratio; surface densities over two-sided disk area 2 pi R_FWHM^2; HI estimated via Zhang+09; linear regressions
assumptions: For CO-unresolved galaxies, CO radius = optical Petrosian radius / 1.6

recipe.goal: Star formation efficiency and gas fraction
recipe.method: SFE = SFR/M_H2, empirical arctan parametrisation vs L_IR (Eqn 7); f_H2 = M_H2/(M_H2+M*) with M_H2/M* = tau x sSFR

evidence.quote: We identify 49 galaxies (out of 67) with a >5σ peak line detection
We get an average rms level of 1.6 mJy beam−1 (at 50 km s−1)

evidence.loc: 3.2 Correlations between L IR and L′CO
evidence.quote: with a median of (0.3 ± 0.1) × 1010 K km s−1 pc2

evidence.loc: 3.2 Correlations between L IR and L′CO

evidence.quote: the mean and scatter of the R P,Opt /R P,CO distribution are 1.6 ± 0.5

evidence.loc: 3.2 Correlations between L IR and L′CO

score_reason: Public data and a fair description of methods and Table 2 values, but custom pipeline and several imaging/fit details are missing.
rediscovery_reason: Archival data, simple per-source recipe (cube, Gaussian fit, flux, L'CO), numeric results in Table 2.
